reviews.comment:
Pase 4/5 veces ,parada  obligada para cargar combustible , tomar un café o un refresco , teniendo 1 o 2 personas o ninguna adelante siempre hay demora. Un café con leche el 14/01/25 $4.200 carísimo.

(Translated by Google)
I passed by 4 or 5 times; it's a mandatory stop for fuel, coffee, or a soft drink. Even with only one or two people ahead, or no one at all, there's always a delay. A coffee with milk on January 14, 2025, cost $4,200—extremely expensive.

reviews.comment:
(Translated by Google) Next to customs. A mandatory stop to refuel before crossing into Chile (the next gas station is 160km away) or on the way back to Argentina (where there are no more gas stations until you descend the mountain range).
As it is the only indispensable option, prices are above normal. But it is the only condition to arrive in Chile with fuel.

(Original)
Ao lado da aduana. Parada obrigatória para abastecer antes de atravessar para o Chile (o próximo posto fica a 160km) ou na volta pra Argentina ( que não existe mais posto até a descida da cordilheira).
Como é única opção  indispensável, os preços são acima do normal. Mais é a única condição pra chegar com combustível no Chile

reviews.comment:
Ayer 10/12/24 volviendo de Chile cargamos combustible, no tenían internet, esperamos hicimos transferencia y el tipo que nos atendió no nos cargó los puntos. Desastre, no es la primera vez, estando en el paso fronterizo no pude ser que les falle el internet 🙄 pésimo

(Translated by Google)
Yesterday, December 10th, 2024, returning from Chile, we filled up with fuel. They didn't have internet access, so we waited, made a transfer, and the guy who helped us didn't credit our points. A disaster! It's not the first time. Being at the border crossing, it's unacceptable that their internet failed. 🙄 Terrible.

reviews.comment:
Muy buena atencion. Gracias al El señor Javier Rolando que trabaja alli, pude recuperar mi toalla que habia dejado olvidada en la habitacion cuando me hospede en el hotel del aca 20 dias antes. Cuando regrese alli le pregunte si la habian visto y me la habia guardado. Un genio!!!

(Translated by Google)
Excellent service. Thanks to Mr. Javier Rolando, who works there, I was able to retrieve my towel, which I had left in my room when I stayed at the hotel 20 days earlier. When I returned, I asked him if they had seen it, and he had kept it for me. He's a gem!
